 Ho Chi Minh City experienced early but light rain.
 Early this weekend, a sudden shower fell in many parts of Ho Chi Minh City, but the rain wasn't heavy, it stopped quickly, and the day turned sunny.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 14/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Some weak disturbances caused rain in central Ho Chi Minh City, while other areas in Southern Vietnam experienced heavier rainfall - Photo: WD
 This morning, November 15th, Ho Chi Minh City experienced early rain. The sky was cloudy, and around 6 am, some areas experienced light rain. The shower caused many people unprepared for the rain to seek temporary shelter under awnings.
 The early rains were caused by the weak presence of wind disturbances affecting the Southern region of Vietnam.
 You may also like The rain will soon end, with changing cloud cover during the day, sunny periods, and scattered showers and thunderstorms in the evening and night, with moderate to heavy rain in some areas. During thunderstorms, be wary of tornadoes, lightning, hail, and strong gusts of wind.
 The rainy season in Southern Vietnam is also gradually coming to an end across the region. This is a transitional period, and the atmosphere is unstable due to the intermingling of various weather patterns, so it is necessary to be prepared for extreme meteorological and hydrological phenomena.
